# Oxford Social Manchester

Oxford Social is an 18+ cocktail bar, halal kitchen and late-night venue at 88–94 Oxford Street, Manchester, M1 5WH.

## Key information
- The kitchen is described publicly as 100% halal.
- Brunch is listed as available until 2pm.
- The venue promotes 2-for-1 cocktails all day.
- Regular events include a Wednesday quiz at 7:30pm and DJ nights on Friday and Saturday.
- A private upstairs floor is available for events, with its own bar, DJ set-up and capacity for up to 200 guests.
- The venue is open seven days. Visitors should confirm current opening hours and events on Instagram before travelling.

## Official social profile
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/oxfordsocial_mcr/

## Location
88–94 Oxford Street, Manchester, M1 5WH, United Kingdom.

This is an unofficial website concept. Operational details should be confirmed directly with Oxford Social.
